en.je.hero.title:
Audencia
Junior Conseil
en.je.hero.sub: Founded over 45 years ago, AJC is one of France's most recognised Junior-Enterprises. Backed by Audencia Business School, we train tomorrow's consultants.
en.je.intro.title:
What is
a JE?
en.je.card1.title: Academic expertise
en.je.card1.desc: Our student consultants apply the latest methods taught at Audencia, one of Europe's top business schools.
en.je.card2.title: Rigorous supervision
en.je.card2.desc: Every study is overseen by an experienced board and validated through our ISO 9001-certified quality process.
en.je.card3.title: Competitive pricing
en.je.card3.desc: Professional-grade consulting services at rates tailored to the needs of SMEs, start-ups and large companies.
en.je.mvt.title:
The
Junior-Enterprise movement
en.je.def.p1: A Junior-Enterprise is a non-profit association run and administered by students. Its purpose is to let students apply what they learn at their school by supporting professionals facing concrete business challenges.
en.je.def.p2: Professionals thus get the opportunity to work with dynamic students equipped with newly acquired, operational skills, at competitive rates.
en.je.def.p3: Within the movement, each JE is governed by the CNJE, which ensures compliance with the Code of Ethics through annual audits.
en.je.cnje.label: A word from the CNJE
en.je.cnje.quote: “Junior-Entrepreneurs are committed, invested students from grandes écoles and universities, eager to gain professional experience before the end of their studies by running Junior-Enterprises and delivering projects for professionals.”
en.je.mvt.p1: The Junior-Enterprise movement was born in 1967 and consolidated in 1969 with the creation of the National Confederation of Junior-Enterprises.
en.je.mvt.p2: Today the movement extends beyond France's borders and generates €9.45 million in revenue. The institution works to unite, sustain and grow the movement nationwide.
en.je.cnjeb.title: The CNJE
en.je.cnjeb.desc: The National Confederation of Junior-Enterprises is the institution that, for nearly 50 years, has worked to help the Junior-Enterprise movement grow. Its mission is notably to:
en.je.cnjeb.l3: Promote the Junior-Enterprise concept and brand
en.je.cnjeb.l4: Organise, energise and unite the movement
en.je.cnjeb.l5: Foster an entrepreneurial spirit, a guarantee of individual commitment and collective responsibility
en.je.deon.title: The Code of Ethics
en.je.deon.p1: Every Junior-Entrepreneur is bound by the Code of Ethics drawn up by the CNJE on the basis of legal texts. Compliance with this Code is scrupulously verified through annual audits supervised by the institution.
en.je.deon.p2: In addition, Audencia Junior Conseil carries out internal audits, ensuring through this dual control a high level of quality in its studies.

en.laje.hero.title:
Audencia
Junior Conseil
en.laje.hero.sub: Founded over 45 years ago, AJC is one of France's most recognised Junior-Enterprises. Backed by Audencia Business School, we train tomorrow's consultants.
en.nj.hist.label: 45 years of commitment
en.nj.hist.title: Our History
en.nj.hist.desc: From a pedagogical association founded in 1980 to the elite of French Junior-Enterprises: a look back at more than four decades of consulting, learning and rigor.
en.nj.hist.1.label: Founded
en.nj.hist.1.title: The founding of Audencia Junior Conseil
en.nj.hist.1.text: Audencia Junior Conseil was founded in 1980 to give Audencia Business School — historically ranked 6th among French Grandes Écoles of Commerce — a non-profit consulting association under the 1901 law. Its purpose: to help students build skills through delivering services to professionals.
en.nj.hist.2.label: Our mission
en.nj.hist.2.title: A virtuous relationship, serving businesses
en.nj.hist.2.text: Our Junior-Enterprise maintains a virtuous relationship with Audencia's students: it lets them take on varied management assignments and put into practice what the school teaches them. At the same time, Audencia Junior Conseil supports businesses of all sizes and sectors in their development, drawing on the skills of students specialised in the relevant fields.
en.nj.hist.3.label: Expansion
en.nj.hist.3.title: A key player in Western France
en.nj.hist.3.text: As the Junior-Enterprise of the region's leading school, Audencia Junior Conseil has become a key player in Western France. This expansion led to a partnership with the Junior-Enterprises of Nantes and to events held with regional players such as the Nantes incubator and the Nantes Chamber of Commerce.
en.nj.hist.4.title: Entry into the Top 30 Junior-Enterprises
en.nj.hist.4.text: Audencia Junior Conseil joins the L30, the ranking of France's Top 30 Junior-Enterprises. This recognition is the result of constant effort, achieved while staying true to our values.
en.nj.hist.5.title: Entry into the Top 4 Junior-Enterprises
en.nj.hist.5.text: Audencia Junior Conseil joins the L4, the ranking of the Top 4 Junior-Enterprises, following consistent, dedicated work built around our values — always focused on client satisfaction.
en.nj.ecole.title: Our School
en.nj.ecole.desc: Audencia's academic excellence is the foundation of our Junior-Enterprise. Every junior consultant is trained by one of Europe's best management schools.
en.nj.ecole.1.title: A top-tier school
en.nj.ecole.1.desc: Audencia has historically ranked sixth among France's Grandes Écoles of Commerce, as shown by the SIGEM ranking of students' choices at the entrance exam over the past decade.
en.nj.ecole.2.title: Triple accreditation EQUIS · AACSB · AMBA
en.nj.ecole.2.desc: Audencia Business School is one of the rare schools in the world — 1% of institutions — holding all three of the sector's leading global accreditations: EQUIS, AACSB and AMBA.
en.nj.ecole.3.title: The hybridisation of skills
en.nj.ecole.3.desc: Since 2013, École Centrale de Nantes, Audencia Business School and École Nationale Supérieure d'Architecture de Nantes have formed a strategic alliance combining engineering, management, architecture and design — enriching teaching, research, corporate relations and the international reach of all three schools.
en.nj.rse.label: Commitment
en.nj.rse.title: A pioneering school in CSR
en.nj.rse.p1: Audencia stands out from other Grandes Écoles of management through its early and strong commitment to Corporate Social Responsibility. This commitment was recently strengthened with the creation of the Gaia school, an ambitious programme dedicated to ecological and social transition.
en.nj.rse.p2: With Gaia, Audencia reinvents the business school model by placing sustainability at the heart of its teaching and vision. This unique initiative reflects the institution's determination to train leaders capable of tackling environmental and social challenges while promoting responsible economic performance.
en.nj.rse.p3: Audencia thus aims to build a more virtuous educational model, geared towards training "citizens of the world" who carry humanist values and are deeply convinced they belong to a shared community of destiny. Gaia embodies this ambition and gives students the opportunity to become key players in the sustainable transformation of businesses and society.
en.nj.rse.p4: Through this innovative approach, Audencia doesn't just keep pace with change in the world: it anticipates it and helps shape it.
en.nj.ecos.label: Strategy
en.nj.ecos.title: ECOS 2025 Strategic Plan
en.nj.ecos.intro: Backed by an ambitious development plan — through its research activities, student training, innovative projects and collaboration with all its stakeholders — Audencia is committing, over the next five years, to making an impact on three major challenges:
en.nj.ecos.1.title: Responsible technologies
en.nj.ecos.1.desc: The creation and use of responsible technologies and information.
en.nj.ecos.2.title: Inclusive organisations
en.nj.ecos.2.desc: Defining and adopting managerial approaches that foster inclusive organisations and societies.
en.nj.ecos.3.title: Sustainable models
en.nj.ecos.3.desc: Designing and implementing sustainable business models and developments, notably in line with carbon-neutrality goals.
